basis: Explicit fictional October operating story; not observed events, empirical calibration or a forecast

story.hiring: Managed Services recovery and Data/AI expansion; fill explicit existing vacancies first, with separately identified new funded slots. Late-month starts follow October application/offer/acceptance events; no backdated September funnel events.
story.exits: Digital contraction clusters October 8-10, Consulting October 14-17; other exits distributed across October. Fixed unit totals; deterministic weighted country/level selection varies composition without independent dashboard noise.
story.mobility: 15 same-grade cross-unit transfers and 15 promotions on October 20-24. No proficiency improvement inferred from mobility.
story.vacancies: 115 prior vacancies filled, 56 expansion slots filled, 80 replacement vacancies opened, 36 exited slots retired: 197 - 115 + 80 = 162 month-end vacancies. Internal moves close and replace their assigned slot, budget-neutral under the retained lifecycle convention.
story.headcount: 9037 + 171 external starts - 116 exits = 9092; internal moves cancel company-wide. Corporate headcount flat after two transfers; other units have distinct expansion/contraction paths.
story.unchangedEvidence: No new survey wave, performance rating, external market observation or incumbent skill assessment. New hires have no skill assessment until explicitly modeled separately. September evidence keeps its original date.
